report:
1. A list of findings.
- Gold price today (as of August 24, 2026) is approximately $4,659.92 per troy ounce, up 1.14% on the day and up about 14.29% over the past month. [https://tradingeconomics.com/commodity/gold]
- The past month's rally (roughly 14% gain) was primarily driven by a weaker US dollar; a US Treasury buyback support plan pushed the dollar to multi-month lows, boosting bullion appeal. [https://tradingeconomics.com/commodity/gold]
- Softer US economic data, including cooling CPI and a decline in July payrolls, reduced expectations for further Federal Reserve rate hikes, which supported gold prices. [https://www.gold.org/goldhub/gold-focus/2026/08/unearthed-whats-behind-golds-august-rally]
- Gold ETF flows picked up sharply in August and central banks continued buying, adding to upward pressure, though the rally was described as tactical rather than broad-based with quiet seasonal demand from China and India. [https://www.gold.org/goldhub/gold-focus/2026/08/unearthed-whats-behind-golds-august-rally]
- Geopolitical risk also contributed, with the US threatening Iran with major financial sanctions, increasing safe-haven demand. [https://tradingeconomics.com/commodity/gold]
- Earlier in the summer, gold reacted to soft June inflation data and dollar baseline movements, indicating macro and currency factors dominated the past month's price action. [https://www.goldpriceforecast.com/gold-price-analysis/]
